review.assumptionsToDischarge: An original cyclotomic Fricke weight image gives a Laurent representation of the actual cusp form: multiply its Laurent numerator by the actual discriminant power and divide by the nonzero original Eisenstein factor. Uniqueness against the actual q-expansion proves every coefficient lies in the original cyclotomic field. For Gamma1, derive period one, width-N periodicity and cusp boundedness, identify the width-one coefficients, and consume the proved actual Fricke-image span. The actual weight-two Gamma1 cusp space is therefore spanned over the complex numbers by cusp forms with cyclotomic Fourier coefficients.
